verdict: The write pass meets the lens: the ledger, the one-time migration, --timings, the awaiting state with approve <name>, tools/ci dora, the v1.1 bucket, the kit publishing design and the open-ended carve-out are all gone or bounded, each deferral with a trigger. Two gaps remain: 00 0.5 now claims a check that no page defines (Required), and the index page table still describes a section 06 no longer has (Advisory).

findings.defect: 00 0.5 says the scope table has one row per command of 04 and that `tools/ci sequences` checks that every command has a row (decision SC6), but the sequences row of 10 10.2, the id table under it and the acceptance of T004 list no such check, so the claim has no owner and no fixture.
findings.scenario: T004 lands with every fixture its acceptance names and passes. A later task adds a command to 04 4.2 with no 00 0.5 row and `tools/ci all` stays green. The scope table's promise, that every command has a stated first-day need, is then held by nothing, which is the circle this lens exists to catch: the table justifies the commands and nothing checks the table.
findings.change: Either add to the sequences row of 10 10.2 and to T004 a rule and a fixture (every command row of 04 4.2 and 4.3 has a first cell in the 00 0.5 table, and the reverse), or weaken 00 0.5 to say review checks it. The first is the decided form (SC6, decided on 2026-10-08).

findings.defect: The page table of the index still describes 06 as 'kits v3 (local builds), workload, julieta delivery, product kits, publishing path', but 06 now has sections 6.1 to 6.5 and no publishing path; the resolution of R8-index-4 and R8-06-5 was to move only the pointer. The write-pass note lists it as left.
findings.scenario: A reader looking for the kit publishing design follows the index to 06, finds nothing, and cannot tell whether the design was lost or deferred. The Deferred row for publishing and signing product kits is the only place that says it waits.
findings.change: Replace 'publishing path' in the 06 row of the index page table with a link to the Deferred row (publishing and signing product kits).

confidence: Medium-high on the two findings (both checked against the baseline text); medium on the carried-forward resolutions, where I checked the presence of the decided text by grep and a read of the cited sections, not every cross-reference.
